summary: APM feed c075_nic is degraded: APM eth1 is discarding 4.01% (485,640 packets) because its capture interface cannot keep up. Link error checks are healthy, so loss is tool-side overload, not network corruption.

findings.root_cause: APM eth1 capture pipeline overloaded - tool discarded 485,640 packets it received (4.01% loss, threshold 0.1%). Link is healthy, so this is not network loss but the APM NIC/tool cannot sustain the offered rate.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM missing ~4% of packets in both directions it requires; results in incomplete transaction traces, inaccurate latency/error rates, missed anomalies and gaps in service dependency maps

recommended_fix.why: Distribute c075_nic across multiple APM instances/ports via packet broker load-balancing (5-tuple hash preserves both directions per flow) to keep per-interface rate below 10Gbps and eliminate drops. Since APM needs_full_payload=false, adding slicing/filtering as secondary reduction is also safe if single tool must be retained.
